text_block_list.text:
Apparently people from the shopping
district in
Kokura are coming to see the
race today.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Kokura's so far from here. Why would
they
bother?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Because getting to root for you is worth any
trouble.

text_block_list.text: Grrr... Again with your cheesy remarks...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: But it's true they're all rooting for me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
...I have to win, then. After all, their
support is
what led me here.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I have to give it my all... no matter how
fast the
others are.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's probably talking about Mejiro
McQueen
and Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having gained new rivals, Найс Нэйчер
is... fired
up!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I can't let them see me fail.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I can do it... I can run just as fast as those
runners!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'll run with all I got—all the way to the
top of the
podium!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
